schema.description: This is an object representing when an appointment was canceled.

actor.description: The actor that initiated the cancellation (user ID or bearer token ID).

anyOf.description: This is an object representing a cancellation reason.

name.description: The name of the cancellation reason.

sort_order.description: The sort order of the cancellation reason.

anyOf.title: CancellationReason

custom_reason_text.description: Custom reason text for the cancellation.

initiated_by.description: The entity that initiated the cancellation.

occurred_at.description: The time at which the cancellation occurred (ISO-8601 format).

source.description: The source of the cancellation event.

schema.title: CancellationEvent
